_comment: Corpus-wide loanword allowlist: Arabic-origin terms so well established in English that NotebookLM says them perfectly and they should be KEPT (not translated, not respelled). Used by scripts/podcast/knowledge/term_render.py tier 1. Keys matched via pronunciation_ledger.normalize_key; the value is the canonical English spelling to emit. Concept terms that the house style TRANSLATES instead (sharia -> 'sacred law', tawhid -> 'Divine Oneness') deliberately do NOT live here.
